_comment: Example only, never required by CI. Each argv element is expanded on its own ({source} {workdir} {listen_port} {container} {python}) and executed without a shell. Locally installed binaries are assumed; container variants need host-loopback reachability to the echo backends, which this harness does not establish (on Docker Desktop, container loopback is not host loopback).
_kong-deck: Deliberately absent: a decK dump is replayed with `deck gateway sync` against a database-backed Kong, which this harness does not run. decK-specific keys such as _info are not guaranteed to load in DB-less Kong, and replaying a dumped basic-auth hash re-hashes it, so kong-deck fixtures stay documentation-inferred.
